_what: How an adapter keeps ONE message of its own on a surface where several writers can post (owned-upsert.mjs): the message is found by a hidden marker AND its author (anyone can copy a marker), made if absent, rewritten if present, and never written if the thing it speaks about moved on while it was being composed. `outcomes` name what a run ends in; `words` say each in plain words for a log or the person.

words.overtaken: The thing moved on while this message was being made, so it was not posted.
words.duplicates: {count} older copies of this message were found and left alone.
